title: 艾尼维亚·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 冰蓝晶羽层叠展开，尖锐冠羽与棱角鲜明的尾羽相互呼应。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Anivia is a majestic ice phoenix with layered crystalline blue feathers, a long avian neck, pointed icy crest, expansive wings, and long angular tail feathers. Preserve correct bird anatomy, two grounded taloned feet, and her unmistakable frozen plumage rather than a humanoid body. Her bright eyes are composed, and the crystalline forms have clear drawn facets without threatening splinters or injured creatures.
art_direction.scene: A gently elevated three-quarter arrangement, the signature motif nearest the viewer, modest accurate perspective and fresh reflected colors. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: ice blue, cobalt, snowy ivory, pale sunrise gold; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
